pairs.registryProposal: The golden path's accessibility posture asks every table for a caption or accessible name, but none of the 11 techniques owns that rule. A seat can therefore only record a missing caption (this table has none) as a golden-path note, not as a technique verdict. Consider giving it a technique, or listing it inside grid-keyboard-model.

pairs.evidence: features/budget/BudgetMirrorPage.tsx:440 Both budget tables take their accessible name from the section heading. They sort by a total order that puts absent values last, cap the window with an honest remainder line, and show an unavailable data layer differently from an empty one, so the earlier deviation (no scope or caption) no longer holds.

features/budget/BudgetMirrorPage.tsx:440 Native table, a small peer set, one button per row. Header cells in thead give column association without scope.

pairs.evidence: features/civicscore/components/LeaderboardTable.tsx:572 Four client-side filter axes (club, name search, workhorse flavour, dossier) have no single clear action. The empty state is a fixed sentence ('try another name or party') that never names the applied filters, so it points the reader at the wrong axes when a workhorse or dossier filter is what emptied the list.

techniques.evidence: features/civicscore/components/LeaderboardTable.tsx:572 No clear-all affordance; only the club axis has an 'all' button. The empty copy is not built from the applied filters. The count, by contrast, is a polite status message and says 'shown'.
features/civicscore/getLeaderboardData.ts:217 Total order: Czech collation passed explicitly, pspId as tiebreaker. lens.ts:176 uses the same comparator.
features/civicscore/CivicScorePage.tsx:212 A null loader renders 'Živá data z grafu nedostupná' (live graph data unavailable), which is distinct from the filtered-empty state.
features/civicscore/components/LeaderboardTable.tsx:132 Rows are memoized on stable props: a primitive inDuel and a single onToggleDuel taken from the duel hook, not a per-row closure.
features/civicscore/components/LeaderboardTable.tsx:411 All-client over the complete 207-MP chamber, a set bounded by the size of the chamber.

features/money/components/TiesLedger.tsx:326 Native table, 25 rows per page, one link per row. A native table fits.
